SENSITIVE_DATA_ACCESS.title: Reasonable Security Safeguards
SENSITIVE_DATA_ACCESS.requirement: The Data Fiduciary shall protect personal data in its possession or under its control by taking reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breach.
SENSITIVE_DATA_ACCESS.failure: Customer PII was accessed by an unauthorized account, indicating failure to implement reasonable security safeguards.

SENSITIVE_DATA_ACCESS.title: Data Breach Notification
SENSITIVE_DATA_ACCESS.requirement: In the event of a personal data breach, the Data Fiduciary shall give the Board and each affected Data Principal notice of such breach.
SENSITIVE_DATA_ACCESS.failure: Access to customer PII data (full dump, emails, phone numbers) constitutes a potential personal data breach requiring notification.

AUDIT_TRAIL_TAMPERING.title: Reasonable Security Safeguards
AUDIT_TRAIL_TAMPERING.requirement: The Data Fiduciary shall protect personal data by taking reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breach.
AUDIT_TRAIL_TAMPERING.failure: Destruction of audit trails indicates insufficient safeguards to protect the integrity of security monitoring systems.

SELF_DELETION.title: Reasonable Security Safeguards
SELF_DELETION.requirement: The Data Fiduciary shall protect personal data by taking reasonable security safeguards.
SELF_DELETION.failure: Ability of an account to self-delete after accessing personal data indicates inadequate identity lifecycle controls.
